title: Subagent orchestration becomes a first-class frontier-API primitive by Q1 2027
body: GPT-5.6's broad rollout did more than extend the price ladder: Sol ships with a max reasoning effort setting and an ultra mode that fans complex tasks out to subagents, meaning the flagship product path now treats multi-agent decomposition as a built-in execution strategy rather than something developers wire up themselves with frameworks. The same week's releases show the pull is industry-wide — Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 is explicitly built for agentic work and leads on scaled tool-use benchmarks like MCP Atlas, and Microsoft's MDASH harness orchestrates over 100 specialized agents across frontier and distilled models in production to find Windows vulnerabilities. The capability frontier is shifting from single-model reasoning depth to orchestrated fan-out: routing subtasks to cheaper distilled tiers, debating intermediate results, and aggregating. The prediction: by Q1 2027, at least two frontier API providers expose server-side subagent orchestration as a documented, billable API primitive — a request-level control (like ultra mode) where the provider spawns, schedules, and meters child agents internally, with pricing that mixes tiers (Sol-class planners delegating to Luna-class workers). Once orchestration lives behind the API, benchmark and pricing competition moves from per-token model quality to per-task orchestrated throughput, and mid-tier models like Terra and Muse Spark become the volume workhorses inside other models' fan-outs.

reasoning.because: GPT-5.6 ultra mode ships provider-side subagent fan-out in the flagship API path
reasoning.given: Multi-tier price ladders make planner-delegates-to-cheap-worker economics structurally attractive
reasoning.so_that: At least two frontier providers expose server-side subagent orchestration as a billable API primitive
reasoning.landing: By Q1 2027, OpenAI plus one of Meta, Google, or Anthropic
reasoning.plain_language: AI companies will soon sell a button that makes one smart model split a big job among cheaper helper models automatically.

summary: GPT-5.6's ultra mode fans tasks out to subagents inside OpenAI's own stack, as Meta and Microsoft push agentic tool use the same week. Expect two or more frontier API providers to sell server-side subagent orchestration as a metered primitive by Q1 2027, shifting competition to per-task throughput.
